senses.gloss: c. (לְקשׁ) slow, late (in the season); late rain; late-born (cmp. אָפִיל).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 11:14">Targ. Deut. XI, 14</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="L00519"><he>לַקִּ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 26:4">Targ. Y. Lev. XXVI, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 6:3">Targ. Hos. VI, 3</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26:3">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>ל׳ לסטים</he>, v. <cite ref="B00789"><he>בַּכִּיר</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>לְקִישִׁין</he>, <he>לְקִישַׁיָּא</he>, <cite ref="L00695"><he>לַקִּי׳</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="L00694"><he>לְקִישָׁן</he></cite>.
